header.title: MAST BLOCK: DANFOSS PVG 32 - 6 FUNCTIONS / HYDRAULIC SYSTEM — DIAGRAM

notes: Six repeated PVG 32 function sections are visible, plus a common inlet/control section at left and an end section at right. Common labels visibly include P, T, LS and M at the inlet, work ports A/B across the top, and LS_A/LS_B along the bottom of sections. Fine-print component/cartridge part numbers, internal valve identifiers, and most pressure-setting annotations are too small to read reliably; one pressure marking near the inlet appears to be 300 bar but should be verified at higher resolution. Dashed blue block boundaries and several auxiliary/shuttle/compensator symbols are visible within the slices. No manifold-wide overall capacity is printed; shown flow values are per-function spool ratings.

UP command (>5 V, B): the proportional spool shifts to its B position, routing pressure from P through the spool to work port B while the opposite work port returns through the spool to T; both work-port destinations continue off the crop.
Overpressure: the branch marked 300 opens from the red pressure-side passage to the blue T/return rail when its threshold is reached.

B-port overpressure: the B work-port relief opens at the shown setting and diverts B-port oil to the blue return/T rail.
